Third Turkish drone attack in 2023 | Child injured in Al-Raqqah countryside

Al-Raqqah province: A Turkish drone targeted a site in Al-Khalidiyah village, west of SDF-controlled Ain Issa district in Al-Raqqah countryside, injuring a child. The victim was taken to a hospital for treatment.

It is worth noting that this is the third Turkish drone attack in January 2023.

On January 3, Syrian Observatory activists reported that three SDF members were killed by a Turkish drone strike that hit a site in Tel Tawil at the northern entrance Al-Hasakah city.
